title: Tennyson
subtitle: Contemporary Architectural Residence
description: Our client’s brief is to have a contemporary home with large windows and high ceiling throughout. With the site oriented to face primarily east and west, we designed this double storey home with the upper floor gently overhanging the floor below to provide some shade over the large and expansive windows desired. Then we provide deep recesses to a band of full height windows on the upper floor and adds vertical elements at interval to also provide shade and breaks the otherwise monotonous glazed look. Dark timber cladding is used as infill panel and function as additional screening against the harsh sun on the western facade. The simplicity of its rectangular exterior form echoes through the internal space as well. High floor to ceiling space with edge-to-edge full height windows are featured in all bedrooms. Living areas are provided with generous amount of windows and skylight to upper floor lounge. A subtly curved staircase is moulded and become the centrepiece of the house which are carried continuously through both floors to soften the interior space. Kitchen and bathrooms are also designed with strong rectangular form and the accent of occasional curve lines.

title: Kooyong
subtitle: Bespoke Multi-Residential
description: With a site area of merely 327sqm, our client has tasks us with a challenge to accommodate two townhouses within this highly sought-after location in Armadale. While getting through various authority for planning approval was itself a challenge, the spatial planning itself is no simple task to fit bedrooms and amenities expected for a modern family. With neighbouring dwellings built to boundary, the lot is heavily constraint and was designed from outside in to maximise building footprint available. External façade finishes take inspiration from immediate neighbours to provide a consistent street rhythm and to maximise building mass with minimum visual bulk. Internally, living areas are designed to be of open plan style with custom integrated joinery to make use of any nooks and corners available to maximise storage space. The development also managed to have a generous basement level capable of providing additional living space, wine storage, bath and laundry facility. Light colour timber finishes are being used throughout and both townhouses also feature floor to ceiling glazing, open tread timber stairs and glazed floor to maximise day light penetration to all living areas. Kitchen and bathroom also follow through similar theme with pale timber finishes matched with ultra-thin porcelain stone finish and minimalistic fixtures to create bright, spacious, and refined interior space.

description: The project was a transformation of a heritage solid brick Edwardian residence, with a full renovation of the existing house and an upstairs extension, located in the prestigious Gascoigne Estate, close to Central Park, Malvern & Caulfield stations.
